meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 运行后,Claude 会组建一个 5 人安全团队(3 名漏洞猎手、2 名 PoC 工程师),并行审查代码库,验证漏洞是否可被利用、归类根因并给出严重性结论,最后输出带 PASS/BLOCK 等判定和修复建议的报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“security-research”等触发词,或要求做安全审查、漏洞审计、发布前安全检查等时触发;需已开启团队模式并处于主会话。没有指定目标时会自动审查当前仓库。

say.text: 用 security-research 审查当前仓库的代码安全。
say.note: 会并行审查并输出带严重性和修复建议的报告。

say.text: 对这个 PR 的改动做一次漏洞可利用性审计。
say.note: 会核查 diff 并尝试用 PoC 证明或推翻发现。

say.text: 帮我校验一下这个威胁模型是否成立。
say.note: 会按攻击路径而非泛泛建议来验证。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a 5-member security team (3 hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, prove whether findings are exploitable, classify root causes, calibrate severity, and output a structured report with verdict and fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "security-research" or asks for a security review, vulnerability audit, or pre-release check. Requires team mode + main session; else the current repo is audited.

say_en.text: Run security-research on the current repository.
say_en.note: It audits in parallel and reports severity and fixes.

say_en.text: Audit exploitability of the changes in this PR.
say_en.note: It checks the diff and tries PoCs to prove or refute findings.

say_en.text: Validate whether this threat model holds.
say_en.note: It verifies via attack paths, not generic advice.
